# ⑤ Rite of Spring

[Brand Design](http://patrickszot.webflow.io/older-work/rite-of-spring#)

[Video Production / Motion Design](http://patrickszot.webflow.io/older-work/rite-of-spring#)

[Art Direction](http://patrickszot.webflow.io/older-work/rite-of-spring#)

Rite of Spring is a self-published novel which explores interaction design and modality. Rite of Spring started as scribbled thoughts in an clunky, coptic-bound journal. The paper itself was thick, pressed by hand, and difficult to write on. Its pages were covered in cursive-written notes, half-finished pieces of prose and poetry, and stuffed passed the edges with found objects like train tickets, polaroids and other printed things. Over time it formalized in to a bound book and now takes the form of a website. The visual system for the book has been designed to celebrate and maintain evidence of that fact no matter what form it takes. ‍
